DIAGNOSIS READY: Hyperglycemic Hyperosmolar State (HHS)

The patient's presentation of aggressive behavior, autonomic dysregulation (diaphoresis, excessive activity), and altered mental status, combined with the absence of fever or gastrointestinal symptoms, strongly suggests severe hyperglycemia rather than gastroenteritis. The initial request for basic metabolic and urine panels was appropriate to confirm this.
